```{r, setup, echo = FALSE}
library(tensormodels)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

safe_tensor_mle <- function(draws, model) {
  tryCatch(
    tensor_mle(draws, model = model, quiet = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        mu = NA,
        sigmas = NA,
        loglik = NA_real_,
        k = NA_real_,
        AIC = NA_real_,
        BIC = NA_real_,
        failed = TRUE,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}

model_compare <- function(draws) {
  res_normal <- safe_tensor_mle(draws, model = "normal")
  res_skewt <- safe_tensor_mle(draws, model = "skewt")
  res_vargam <- safe_tensor_mle(draws, model = "vargamma")
  res_invgauss <- safe_tensor_mle(draws, model = "invgauss")
  res_genhyper <- safe_tensor_mle(draws, model = "genhyper")

  all_mod <-
    tibble(
      model = c("Normal", "Skewt", "Vargamma", "Invgauss", "Genhyper"),
      loglik = c(
        res_normal$loglik,
        res_skewt$loglik,
        res_vargam$loglik,
        res_invgauss$loglik,
        res_genhyper$loglik
      ),
      k = c(
        res_normal$k,
        res_skewt$k,
        res_vargam$k,
        res_invgauss$k,
        res_genhyper$k
      ),
      AIC = c(
        res_normal$AIC,
        res_skewt$AIC,
        res_vargam$AIC,
        res_invgauss$AIC,
        res_genhyper$AIC
      ),
      BIC = c(
        res_normal$BIC,
        res_skewt$BIC,
        res_vargam$BIC,
        res_invgauss$BIC,
        res_genhyper$BIC
      ),
      failed = c(
        isTRUE(res_normal$failed),
        isTRUE(res_skewt$failed),
        isTRUE(res_vargam$failed),
        isTRUE(res_invgauss$failed),
        isTRUE(res_genhyper$failed)
      ),
      error = c(
        res_normal$error %||% NA_character_,
        res_skewt$error %||% NA_character_,
        res_vargam$error %||% NA_character_,
        res_invgauss$error %||% NA_character_,
        res_genhyper$error %||% NA_character_
      ),
      mod_obj = list(
        res_normal,
        res_skewt,
        res_vargam,
        res_invgauss,
        res_genhyper
      )
    )

  all_mod
}
```

# Random Draw Validation with Density

```{r, draw-hyper}
lambda <- 2
omega <- 2

mu_true <- array(1:24, dim = c(2, 3, 4))
skew_true <- array(seq(-2, 2, length.out = 24), dim = c(2, 3, 4))
sigmas_true <- list(crossprod(matrix(rnorm(4), nrow = 2)),
                    crossprod(matrix(rnorm(9), nrow = 3)),
                    crossprod(matrix(rnorm(16), nrow = 4)))

draws <- rtgenhyper( #generate rtgenhyper draws
  n = 5e4,
  mu = mu_true,
  skew = skew_true,
  sigmas = sigmas_true,
  lambda = lambda,
  omega = omega
)
```

```{r plot-density-hyper}
dgh_scalar <- function(x, mu_y, skew_y, sigma_y, lambda, omega) {
  vapply(x, function(z) {
    dtgenhyper(
      x = array(z, dim = 1),
      mu = array(mu_y, dim = 1),
      skew = array(skew_y, dim = 1),
      sigmas = list(matrix(sigma_y, 1, 1)),
      lambda = lambda,
      omega = omega
    )
  }, numeric(1))
}

xmat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(draws, as.vector))
Sigma_kron <- Reduce(kronecker, rev(sigmas_true))

dims <- dim(mu_true)
idx <- seq_len(prod(dims))

index_labels <- apply(arrayInd(idx, .dim = dims), 1, function(z) {
  paste0("[", paste(z, collapse = ", "), "]")
})

plot_val <- function(index) {
  y <- xmat[, index] #pull element 

  mu_y <- as.vector(mu_true)[index] #true mean
  skew_y <- as.vector(skew_true)[index] #true skew
  sigma_y <- Sigma_kron[index, index] #true covar

  ggplot(data.frame(y = y), aes(x = y)) +
     geom_density(color = "black") +
    # geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 80, 
    #                color = "black", fill = "pink") + #plot draws
    geom_function(fun = dgh_scalar, #plot true density at element
                  args = list(mu_y, skew_y, sigma_y, lambda, omega),
                  color = "red", linewidth = 0.4, lty = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = paste0("Index ", index_labels[index]), y = "Density")
}

plots <- lapply(idx[seq(1, 24, by = 3)], plot_val) #list of all plots

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4) #wrap together with patchwork
```

# Normal Sim

```{r, normal_sim}
N_grid <- c(50)#, 100, 150)

dims_grid <- list(
  c(2, 3, 4),
  c(3, 4, 4),
  c(3, 4, 5)
)

n_reps <- 25

one_run <- function(N, dims, rep_id) {
  mu_true <- array(seq_len(prod(dims)) / 10, dim = dims)
  sigmas_true <- lapply(dims, diag)

  draws <- rtnorm(
    n = N,
    mu = mu_true,
    sigmas = sigmas_true
  )

  model_compare(draws) |>
    mutate(
      N = N,
      n_star = prod(dims),
      dims = paste(dims, collapse = " x "),
      rep = rep_id,
      rank = rank(BIC, ties.method = "first")
    )
}

sim_res <- crossing(N = N_grid,
                    dims_id = seq_along(dims_grid),
                    rep = seq_len(n_reps)) |>
  mutate(dims = map(dims_id, \(i) dims_grid[[i]])) |>
  pmap_dfr(\(N, dims_id, rep, dims) one_run(N, dims, rep))
```

```{r, normal_sim}
sim_res |> 
  filter(!is.na(BIC)) |> 
  summarize(mean_BIC = mean(BIC), .by = c(model, n_star, N)) |> 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("Normal", "Genhyper", "Invgauss", "Skewt", "Vargamma")),
         n_star = factor(n_star, c(24, 48, 60)),
         bic_label = label_scientific(digits = 3)(mean_BIC)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n_star, y = model)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = mean_BIC), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = bic_label), nudge_y = -0.22, size = 3, color = "gray30") + 
  facet_grid(. ~ N, switch = "x", scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = expression("n^* by N"), y = "Model") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
model_compare <- function(draws) {
  res_normal <- tensor_mle(draws, model = "normal", quiet = FALSE)
  res_skewt <- tensor_mle(draws, model = "skewt", quiet = FALSE)
  res_vargam <- tensor_mle(draws, model = "vargamma", quiet = FALSE)
  res_invgauss <- tensor_mle(draws, model = "invgauss", quiet = FALSE)
  res_genhyper <- tensor_mle(draws, model = "genhyper", quiet = FALSE)

  all_mod <-
    tibble(model = c("Normal", "Skewt", "Vargamma", "Invgauss", "Genhyper"),
    loglik = c(res_normal$loglik, res_skewt$loglik,
               res_vargam$loglik, res_invgauss$loglik, res_genhyper$loglik),
    k = c(res_normal$k, res_skewt$k,
          res_vargam$k, res_invgauss$k, res_genhyper$k),
    AIC = c(res_normal$AIC, res_skewt$AIC,
            res_vargam$AIC, res_invgauss$AIC, res_genhyper$AIC),
    BIC = c(res_normal$BIC, res_skewt$BIC,
            res_vargam$BIC, res_invgauss$BIC, res_genhyper$BIC),
    mod_obj = list(res_normal, res_skewt, res_vargam, res_invgauss, res_genhyper)
  )

  all_mod
}
```
